### NotificationsService

File: `src/modules/notifications/notifications.service.ts`

Properties:
- `logger: unknown = new Logger(NotificationsService.name)`

Methods:
- `sendToDevice(token: string, title: string, body: string, data?: Record<string, string>): unknown` — Send a direct message to a specific device. Useful for targeted alerts (e.g., Substitute Shift Assignment).
- `sendToDevices(tokens: string[], title: string, body: string, data?: Record<string, string>): unknown` — Send a message to multiple specific devices. Useful for alerting all OTHER Linmas when someone claims an incident.
- `sendToTopic(topic: string, title: string, body: string, data?: Record<string, string>): unknown` — Send a broadcast to all users subscribed to a specific topic. Useful for "security\_alerts\_rw07".
